verdict_reason: The COMP window was the cause, and giving it its own budget removes the one-GPU loss: 0795-r1 is not slower than candidate-54 at any grid shape in any of three same-session ABBA comparisons (0795 was 0.16-0.35 ms slower at 9 of the 10 1-4-request shapes, the same harness in another session). The mark's second half holds on balance but not cell by cell: at 1-4 requests the step is faster beyond the two-boot interval in 22 of 30 session-cells and the same in 8, with a lower mean in 28 of 30. One GPU cannot credit the 4 removed RoCE all-gathers, and it under-reads prefetch effects at small batch (TP3 lesson), so the tp4-switched grid spec delivered here decides.

chosen_budget.rule: l2_prefetch.comp_budget(projection): a replicated weight (tp_size 1, TP <= 4 with 0795) gets 0, so no COMP window; a TP rank's 12-bit shard (TP5..TP8, at most 1.97 MB) keeps WO's budget, so it is prefetched whole as before. VLLM_DS41_L2_PREFETCH_COMP_MB, when set, is one budget for every compressor. The recipe sets nothing.
chosen_budget.why_0_not_2MB: Measured in one session (raw/analysis/cells-screen-c0-vs-c2.json): no window against a 2 MB head of the replicated weight (1.97 MB after the 64 KiB slice, the old shard's size) is faster at 1x6, 2x6, 3x6 and 4x12, the same at the other 7 shapes, never slower, and its target forward is lower at all 11 shapes (-0.07..-0.33 ms). Against candidate-54 the 2 MB head was faster at 7 shapes and the same at 4; no window was faster at 10 and the same at 1.
chosen_budget.plans_as_built: TP4 owner layers 2, 8, 14, 20: candidate-54 COMP 2.0/2.0/2.0/1.0 MB shards; 0795 10.5/10.5/10.5/5.2 MB; 0795-r1 none (raw/json/mark-r1-boot*.json model.owner_plans is empty; l2_windows show 'COMP -'). WO stays 18.9 MB, issued after the compressor as before. TP3: candidate-54 2.9/2.9/2.9/1.5 MB; 0795-r1 none.
chosen_budget.tp5_to_tp8: unchanged: the sharded, packed weight keeps WO's 20 MB budget and is prefetched whole (test_compressor_window_has_its_own_budget, tp_size 8). Not measured on a GPU: no TP5+ harness shape, and the code path there is candidate-54's.

fallback: Not needed on one GPU. If the testbed still shows a small-batch loss, the next step is the task's fallback: decode keeps the packed shard and the replicated BF16 copy serves only SP prefill and #956. Choosing by row count is ruled out (the own mark's cold read loses at every row count).

harness.what: round 3's own-mark decode step (h/step957.py, sha256 7ca27617, identical to candidate-56/receipts/own-marks/pr-957/raw/harness/step957.py): the full 40-layer model plus the DSpark drafter's 3 layers on one GB10 at one TP4 rank's shapes, dummy weights, DeepseekCompressor built as TP4 rank 0 (TP3 rank 0 for the TP3 run), the all-gather a local copy stand-in, the engine grid at 4K context, 10 replays, capture ladder 1-32, the recipe's environment (bin/env.sh).
harness.arms: base = spark-ds41f:candidate-54 (sha256:e1de71be, its own tree 5f021d9a, verified 7,831 files). r1 = the same image + 0795-r1's 6 files read-only (files-r1.txt), verified as candidate-54 + 0795-r1 (tree affbc2b0, 7,831 files). r1c0 (screen only) = the screen-time r1 overlay (raw/screen-overlay-v1, tree 44311688: a constant 2 MB COMP budget, verified 7,831 files at the time) with VLLM_DS41_L2_PREFETCH_COMP_MB=0, which builds the same plans as the final default at TP4 (no COMP window).
harness.interval_rule: round 3's: faster when the slower candidate boot beats the faster base boot, slower when the faster candidate boot is slower than the slower base boot, else the same. Cells are each boot's median step (ms); the delta is the mean of two boots minus the mean of two.
harness.sessions: every boot a fresh container under flock /tmp/spark-lab-gpu.lock (bin/om.sh takes it), hold file absent and no serving container at every start (raw/commands-sp8.txt). Other agents' jobs interleaved between boots.
